evidence_spans.text: Mosaic platform uses a cell village of 50 cancer cell lines treated with drugs for 24 hours, then dissociated and profiled via Parse GigaLab.
14 96-well plates were used, with 72-165 sublibraries per plate, totaling 1786 sublibraries.
Dabrafenib is a BRAF-V600E inhibitor.
RMC-6236 is a pan-RAS inhibitor.
Palbociclib showing enrichment in the G1 phase and Dinaciclib in the G2/M phase

treatment with RMC-6236, a pan-RAS inhibitor, produced the greatest effect in the KRAS-mutated group, with the most substantial difference in Vision scores observed at the lowest (p = 0.065, Welch’s t-test) and intermediate (p = 0.063, Welch’s t-test) doses compared to the unmutated RAS group
Across all 379 distinct drugs used in the atlas
Dinaciclib in the G2/M phase

treatment with Dabrafenib elicited the most pronounced effect in cell lines harboring BRAF mutations, as evidenced by significantly lower scores at both the lowest (P = 0.0013, Welch’s t-test) and highest (P = 0.00023, Welch’s t-test) doses, whereas KRAS-mutated lines showed minimal change
these results suggest that cell line identity, followed by cell cycle phase, are the most major factors in driving stratification of the data.

treatment with RMC-6236, a pan-RAS inhibitor, produced the greatest effect in the KRAS-mutated group, with the most substantial difference in Vision scores observed at the lowest (p = 0.065, Welch’s t-test) and intermediate (p = 0.063, Welch’s t-test) doses compared to the unmutated RAS group
we observed higher correlation between conditions with matched treatment and cell identity (estimate q25: 0.97, median: 0.975, q75: 0.98)
with a median of 1,287 cells per condition
As the largest single-cell dataset to date, Tahoe-100M enables artificial-intelligence (AI)-driven models to learn context-dependent functions
Cells had a mean of 2,288 transcripts (median of 1,890)

treatment with Dabrafenib elicited the most pronounced effect in cell lines harboring BRAF mutations, as evidenced by significantly lower scores at both the lowest (P = 0.0013, Welch’s t-test) and highest (P = 0.00023, Welch’s t-test) doses
Of the 50 cell lines in Tahoe-100M, 47 had sufficient representation across the conditions to be evaluated in downstream analyses.
we obtained a dataset comprising 47 cell lines, 379 drugs, 1,135 drug-dose combinations and 52,886 unique cell line-drug-dose conditions
we recovered 100.6 million cells that pass minimal filters and 95.6 million cells that pass full filters
HDAC and microtubule inhibitors induced the greatest G2/M arrest. Within the HDAC inhibitors, Belinostat and Panobinostat predominantly drove this G2/M enrichment
This dataset captures 17,813 unique cell line-drug conditions

Our high-throughput Mosaic platform, composed of a highly diverse and optimally balanced “cell village”, reduces batch effects and enables parallel profiling of thousands of conditions at single-cell resolution at an unprecedented scale.
After sequencing, we obtained ~1.4 trillion raw sequencing reads representing a total of 153 million cells

limitations.statement: Plate 14 served as a biological replicate of Plate 6.
Cancer models and pharmacological compounds were used; the atlas is designed as a broadly applicable perturbation atlas for cell biology.
Drug treatment and dose have a more modest effect on data stratification compared to cell line identity and cell cycle phase.
Data processed with Vevo's filtering criteria; 95.6 million cells pass full filters.
Differential gene expression analyses account for possible batch effects by leveraging DMSO-treated wells included in all plates.
47 cell lines had sufficient representation for downstream analyses.
